relationships.subject: GSK872
relationships.evidence_quote: The upregulation of RIPK3 was wholly reversed after GSK872 treatment (p < 0.05).

relationships.subject: GSK872
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal administration of RIPK3 inhibitor GSK872 could alleviate the mechanical allodynia in SCI rats and reduce the expression levels of RIPK3.

relationships.subject: GSK872
relationships.evidence_quote: Rats treated with GSK872 exhibited lower protein levels of NLRP3 (p < 0.05) and caspase-1 (p < 0.05) compared with the rats in the vehicle group.

relationships.subject: GSK872
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal delivery of GSK872 inhibited the protein level of NF-κB p65, as shown in the GSK872 group (p < 0.05).

relationships.subject: GSK872
relationships.evidence_quote: The protein levels of TNF-α (p < 0.05), IL-1β (p < 0.05), and IL-18 (p < 0.05) were restricted in the GSK872 group compared with the vehicle group.

key_findings: RIPK3 is upregulated in dorsal horn after SCI and its inhibition by GSK872 relieves mechanical allodynia
GSK872 suppresses NLRP3/caspase-1, NF-κB p65, IL-1β, IL-18 and TNF-α
